intro: Each Harvest Source scores its single highest-matching Aspect against the Cosmic Age. Essence is paid in the Element of the Cosmic Age.

steps.label: Harvest Sources
steps.body: Your Zodiac Die, Astral Houses, Adept Cards, and Spread Cards each Align independently with the Cosmic Age.

steps.label: Scoring Tiers
steps.body: Sign Match +3 · Planet Match +2 · Element Match +1. A source that matches all three at once scores +6 (Perfect Match).

steps.label: Gift of the Age
steps.body: Remember: each player already received 1 Essence of the Cosmic Age's Element in Spring. Autumn Harvest is scored separately.

steps.label: Take Your Essence
steps.body: Total your Alignment score and take that many Essence bills from the bank in the Cosmic Age's Element.
